expectation: Nuclear FOXP3 in a small subset of CD4+ T cells (Tregs), scattered singly or enriched in lymphoid aggregates and stroma near immune infiltrates; a sparse, round, nucleus-sized signal in distinct cells over a low background.
notes: FOXP3 shows tissue-wide haze, tiling and bright blobs that also lie off the tissue, and no distinct nuclear population. In the CD4-dense field, FOXP3 shows granular speckle and one blob, with almost no overlap with CD4+ cells.
observed: A: haze follows the tissue outline, with tile blocks and bright dots scattered across tissue and background. B/C: diffuse haze, streaks and a few large blobs, no nuclear cells. D: uniform haze. E: speckle and one bright blob; the merge is mostly magenta with no white.
why: The signal is haze, tiling and debris, not a nuclear subset, and in row E FOXP3 does not fall on the CD4+ cells.
